project_type: Expo / React Native Web POS CRM (mock data, Zustand + persist stores). All work in git worktree.

verification_instructions: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm test` from the worktree root d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\pricing-fix. BASELINE: tsc has exactly 13 pre-existing errors (BranchSelector/DatePicker Typography, settings supplier Module, WebUserStaffScreen Platform, errorTracking) — DO NOT add new errors in touched files; the 13 may remain. npm test: cartAdapter 14/14 pass + engine self-test prints 39 passed/0 failed; 3 suites fail to LOAD (engine.test.ts 'no suite', SyncService.test.ts + branchPermissionStore.test.ts 'Libraries/Image/Image' import) — these 3 load failures are pre-existing and may remain. Do not regress the 14 cartAdapter tests or the 39 engine checks.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Use absolute paths under d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\pricing-fix (step cwd is the parent workspace). Git via `git -C d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\pricing-fix`. No expo-image-picker and no papaparse installed — do NOT add heavy deps; use web FileReader/<input type=file>/Blob and hand-rolled CSV parsing. CSV/image features are web-only (guard Platform.OS==='web').
contribution_requirements: Design-system steering in .kiro/steering: use real tokens src/constants/{colors,typography,spacing}.ts and src/design-system/tokens (webColors) for web screens; components from src/components/ui; ALL user-facing text in Thai; new screens need loading/error/empty states; strict TypeScript, no `any` abuse. Commit locally on branch feat/pricing-fix; NEVER push.
key_patterns: Stores are Zustand+persist (persistStorage). Audit: logAction(module, action, description, metadata?) from src/store/auditLogStore.ts. Cart product id = `${master.id}_${uom.id}`; map to master via masterProducts.find(m => m.id === p.id.split('_')[0]) (see WebPOSScreen.handleProductTap). Active branch via useBranchGuard() -> activeBranchId (default 'b1'). pricingStore.resolvePrice(productId, branchId) is keyed by product CODE (e.g. 'P001'), NOT master id ('p1'); priority branch-temp>branch-perm>central-temp>central-perm, filtered by effective/expiry date. CSV Blob export pattern exists in the dead src/screens/web/WebPricingScreen.tsx (reuse then delete).
